Name: Dinner Guests - Invite Villagers to Eat at Your Farmhouse
Author: XI221
Description:
[size=5][b]Dinner Guests[/b][/size]
You cooked a whole table of food - somebody should come and eat it. Buy a [b]Dinner Invitation[/b] at Pierre's and take it to the villager you want to invite. If they say yes, in the evening they walk over to your place, pick a dish they love from your tables, and sit down to eat.

[size=4][b]Handing out invitations[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Sold at Pierre's, 100g each.[/*]
[*]Hold the invitation and click a villager to invite them (it doesn't count as a gift). All 27 adult villagers can be invited.[/*]
[*]You need 2+ hearts, must invite them before 4 PM, and can have up to four guests a night. Once you've invited someone, wait a week before inviting them again.[/*]
[*]People with plans that day (festivals, weddings, special vanilla events) politely decline. If they say no, you keep the invitation.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]At 5 PM the guests walk over[/b][/size]
Guests set off from wherever they are, [b]walk all the way to your house[/b], come in and say hello.

[size=4][b]Everyone picks a dish they love[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Put the dishes you cooked on the tables in your farmhouse, one dish per table.[/*]
[*]Guests pick their favourite first, then look at quality and distance, sit down at the table and eat. When they finish they say whether it was good.[/*]
[*]Guests chat with each other, and you can join in too.[/*]
[*]At 8:30 PM they thank you and walk home, then carry on with their vanilla evening.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]A good host is remembered[/b][/size]
Whether the food suits them, its quality, whether you chatted with them and whether you stayed home with them all count. The next day each guest sends a thank-you letter and gains friendship - the better the evening, the more.
After a really great evening, a guest may [b]invite you back[/b] a few days later: go to their home that evening, they'll treat you to dinner and send you home with a plate of their signature dish.

[size=4][b]Good to know[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Guests come even when it rains.[/*]
[*]To uninstall, just delete the mod. Any invitations left in your inventory turn into an error item - just throw it away.[/*]
[*]Only runs on the host, and letters go to the host. Multiplayer hasn't been tested yet - please tell me in the comments if something goes wrong.[/*]
[*]May conflict with mods that change villagers' evening schedules.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Feedback wanted[/b][/size]
Did a guest get stuck or walk somewhere strange? Who did you invite? The English text is new - if a line reads wrong, please tell me.

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
SMAPI 4.0+. Languages: English, Chinese.

Fan-made mod; Stardew Valley characters and art belong to ConcernedApe.

[size=4][b]中文[/b][/size]
请村民来吃晚饭：在皮埃尔店里买晚饭请帖（100 金），拿着请帖点村民邀请（两颗心以上、下午四点前、一晚最多四位）。傍晚五点客人一步一步走到你家，在农舍桌上挑一盘爱吃的菜坐下吃，八点半道谢回家。第二天寄感谢信加好感，招待得特别好过几天还会回请你。下雨照常来，卸载直接删 mod（剩下的请帖丢掉即可）。
